body: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse is Atlus's Nintendo 3DS role-playing adventure set during the events of Shin Megami Tensei IV. Nanashi, a young hunter in Tokyo, is killed and revived through an agreement with the deity Dagda. That bargain brings him into a conflict involving the city, its defenders and powers with their own plans for humanity. The familiar landscape gains a different group of companions and a new perspective. Nanashi's relationships become central to deciding what the life returned to him will mean.

Demons can be negotiated with and recruited, then fused to create stronger companions with selected inherited skills. Their elemental resistances matter as much as their attacks. The Press Turn system again allows a weakness to produce further actions, giving preparation an immediate effect once a battle begins. Smirk status changes the strength and properties of particular abilities, rewarding attention to the state of a fighter as well as the enemy's defences. A reliable party needs several useful answers when its preferred attack is no longer safe.

Nanashi's human allies provide support alongside the controlled demon party, bringing their own abilities into encounters. The story gives those relationships more room as its competing powers ask him to choose whom to trust. Familiar locations and systems allow Apocalypse to begin from an established world while rearranging its loyalties. Ryota Kozuka's music accompanies the journey. The result is a separate adventure within the earlier game's crisis, where the viewpoint of a younger survivor turns an enormous conflict into decisions about the people beside him.
story_headings: A party made through conversation and fusion
